name: stochastic oscillator
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 受到随机激励或具有随机参数的振动系统。
scope_note: 本篇对象为高斯白噪声外部激励下、具有偶次非线性项的随机振子。

complete_examples.text: Numerical analysis show that the extended exponential polynomial closure method with polynomial order being six is both effective and efficient for solving the transient analysis of the stochastic oscillator with even nonlinearities by comparing the numerical results obtained by the proposed method with those obtained by Monte Carlo simulation method.

Although many studies have been carried out on in-vestigating the PDF solutions of nonlinear stochastic system as described in the above references, the transient probabilistic analysis of the stochastic oscillator has been seldom studied, especially for the oscillator which contains even nonlinearity.
